scope_support.exclusion_quote: DeLoop learns from these pairs through direct preference optimization
scope_support.feedback_quote: We use a looping action as a negative example and the first later non-looping action in the same rollout as a positive example.
scope_support.object_quote: To reduce these loops, we propose DeLoop, a self-supervised training method.
scope_support.persistence_quote: On Qwen3-32B, DeLoop reduces loops and steps while raising task success from 37.7% to 44.8%.
